CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey

EARLS COURT STATION: From Monday 28 September until Sunday 11 October, no step-free access to/from the eastbound District line. If you are starting an eastbound step-free journey at Earls Court, take a westbound train to Hammersmith and change there for an eastbound train. To complete an eastbound step-free journey at Earls Court: If travelling from Acton Town or Ealing Broadway, use the Piccadilly line from Acton Town. If travelling from Hammersmith, Kew Gardens or Richmond, use the Piccadilly line from Hammersmith. If travelling from Fulham Broadway, Southfields, Wimbledon or Wimbledon Park, take a City-bound District line train and change at Victoria for a westbound train back to Earls Court

Clapham Junction: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between the footbridge and platforms 1 & 2 due to a faulty lift. Use the entrance on Grant Road instead. Call 0343 222 1234 if you need further information.
